name: ThreatIntel AI Engine
description: Evidence-first threat intelligence investigation engine. Supports CVE investigations using NVD, CISA KEV, Red Hat Security Data API, and OSV, with source correlation and comparison over time. Provides vendor-specific product impact assessments and retrieval of previously persisted investigation context.

watchEnabled.description: Run scheduled watchlist monitoring in the gateway. Off by default.

watchNotifyTarget.description: Discord target for watch alerts, for example channel:123456789012345678. Without it, changes are saved but not sent.

watchTickMinutes.description: How often the monitor looks for due checks and pending alerts.

watchDefaultIntervalHours.description: Default hours between checks of a watched CVE.

watchMaxEntries.description: Most CVEs the watchlist may hold.

watchDeliveryMode.description: direct: this plugin's outbox owns retries (default). openclaw_queue: OpenClaw's delivery queue owns retries once it holds an alert.

feedEnabled.description: Run the threat intelligence feed in the gateway. Off by default.

abuseipdbApiKey.description: AbuseIPDB API key for indicator lookups. Without it, AbuseIPDB is reported as not checked.

greynoiseApiKey.description: Optional GreyNoise API key; the community API works without one at a lower limit.

virustotalApiKey.description: VirusTotal API key for indicator lookups (reports only; nothing is submitted). Without it, VirusTotal is reported as not checked.

virustotalPerMinute.description: Most VirusTotal requests per minute. The public API allows 4.

otxApiKey.description: Optional AlienVault OTX API key; OTX works without one at a lower limit.

lookupSources.description: Enabled lookup services: internetdb, greynoise, abuseipdb, otx, virustotal. All by default.

lookupCacheHours.description: Hours a lookup answer is reused before the service is asked again.

lookupPerUserPerHour.description: Most indicator lookups one person may start per hour.

lookupDailyBudgets.description: Most calls per service per UTC day. Defaults: internetdb 2000, greynoise 50, abuseipdb 900, otx 1000, virustotal 450.

feedNotifyTarget.description: Discord target for feed posts, for example channel:123456789012345678.

feedSources.description: Enabled feed sources: cisa-kev, cisa-advisories, cisa-ics, msrc, paloalto, fortinet, cisco, aws, gcp, dfir-report, unit42, cybersecuritynews. All by default.

feedBioPharmaTerms.description: Words tying an item to the Bio/Pharma industry. Built-in industry terms are used when empty.

feedBioPharmaProducts.description: LIMS, laboratory, manufacturing, and OT products used in your Bio/Pharma environments.

feedSecurityProducts.description: Security products in scope: EDR, SIEM, firewall, VPN, IAM, PAM, email security.

feedLogSources.description: Log sources and platforms in scope, for example Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS.

feedMaxPostsPerCycle.description: Most posts per collection cycle; higher priorities go first, the rest wait.

feedCooldownHours.description: Hours before an updated item may be posted again.

feedDedupeDays.description: Days during which a posted CVE is not posted again through another advisory.

feedMaxAgeDays.description: Items older than this are not posted for the first time; waiting items expire at this age.

feedUrgentBypass.description: Let new P1 items with CISA-confirmed exploitation exceed the per-cycle limit.

feedQuietNotice.description: When a cycle has nothing to post, post a short notice with a security concept. On by default.

feedUrgentMaxPerCycle.description: Most urgent posts above the per-cycle limit.
